title: Services: table + cards, grouped
question: Which refined services page do you prefer? (Try the Table/Cards toggle and the panel tabs)

variants.label: Grouped rows
variants.notes: Table split by purpose with group header rows (Web, Containers, System). Panel tabs as a segmented pill. All: Table/Cards toggle (top right) and Info, Logs, Unit file, Dependencies tabs in the side panel.

variants.label: Purpose chips
variants.notes: Purpose filter chips in the toolbar instead of headers, flat table. Wider panel with underline tabs, more room for the unit file. All: Table/Cards toggle (top right) and Info, Logs, Unit file, Dependencies tabs in the side panel.

variants.label: Grouped + icon tabs
variants.notes: Grouped rows like A. Panel tabs as four icon buttons, quicker to hit. All: Table/Cards toggle (top right) and Info, Logs, Unit file, Dependencies tabs in the side panel.
